Composition-attack prevention is an advanced tier of execution integrity; research-stage, no deployments.
Body-worn cameras are the evidence mechanism of two-person integrity (already its completed_by).
Post-employment restrictions act after the weights have left; their useful part is monitoring around departures.

In-house development relocates supply-chain risk to internal developers rather than removing it.
Hard stop for EM shielding, detection-only for tampering.
Quotas are software set by humans; the July 2026 agent worked around throttling.
